text: Return, O Israel, to the LORD; ; your God! for you are weakened by ; your iniquities.

Take after your own words, and return to the LORD! Speak to him! so that you should not receive for your iniquities, and so that you should receive good things, and we will recompense the fruit of our lips.
Assyria in no way shall deliver us; upon a horse we shall not ascend; no longer in any way should we say, Our gods -- to the works ; of our hands. The one among you shall show mercy on the orphan.
I will repair ; their dwellings; I will love them confessedly, for [[2]turned away [1]my anger] from them;
and I will be as dew to; Israel; he shall bloom as a lily, and shall cast ; his roots as ; Lebanon.
[[2]shall go forth; ; [1]His branches], and he will be as [[2]olive [1]a fruitful], and ; his smell as Lebanon.
They shall return and sit under ; his protection; they shall live and shall be fixed firmly in grain, and they shall blossom as a grapevine. The memorial of him is as the wine of Lebanon.
To; Ephraim, what is there; to him yet and to idols? I humbled him, and I shall strengthen him. I am as a juniper being dense. From me ; your fruit has been found.
Who is; wise, and perceives these things? discerning, and recognizes them? For straight are; the ways of the LORD, and the just shall go by them; but the impious shall weaken in them.
